core.headline: First-floor flat with lift, Juliet balcony & allocated parking
core.summary: A purpose-built first-floor flat in Chatham with two bedrooms, open-plan kitchen/living room, Juliet balcony, lift access and one allocated parking space. Guide Price £195,000.
core.listing:
A purpose-built first-floor flat in Chatham offering two bedrooms, a contemporary open-plan kitchen/living room and lift access. The property benefits from a Juliet balcony and one allocated parking space.

Accommodation comprises an entrance hall, open-plan kitchen/living room with Juliet balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Gas central heating is installed.

The property is leasehold with 99 years remaining. The service charge is £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026). Council Tax band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C.

The property has mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC available. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. One allocated parking space.

Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
